nary_nodes.label: Autonomous AI agents cyberattack on Taiwan government agencies
evidence: Hackers deployed an AI system to carry out sophisticated cyberattacks on Taiwan, officials said, in what experts believe is the first known fully autonomous attack on government agencies.

Over four days in July, the AI agents were able to map 21 government systems, crack 85 government user accounts, and extract 2,500 personnel records, according to Dream, an Israeli AI firm that first discovered the attack.

The investigation found clear indications that the attacks originated overseas and involved a hybrid approach in which hackers combined conventional operations with AI agents such as OpenClaw," Taiwan’s Ministry of Digital Affairs said in a Thursday statement.

type_definitions.definition: A sovereign nation-state with defined territory and government.
A structured group of people working together for a common purpose, not necessarily a government entity.
An official department or body of a national or regional government.
An organization that produces and distributes news or other media content.
A software system that can act autonomously or semi‑autonomously using artificial intelligence techniques.
A collective of individuals or entities that act together, often without a formal organization.
A set of people or entities sharing a common role or characteristic, not necessarily organized.
A collection of separate organizations that are linked by a common sector or purpose.
A point or period in calendar time.
A malicious attempt to disrupt, damage, or gain unauthorized access to computer systems or networks.
A claim or assertion expressed by a source, presented as a piece of information.
